tasks.short: Start and monitor pottery production equipment

steps.what: Check actual machine-unit and conveyor readiness and the intended start sequence under the existing approved pottery-production procedure.
inputs: Actual equipment and work area
Existing approved start procedure
outputs: Actual checked readiness and intended start sequence

steps.what: Start the actual machine units within the checked readiness and existing authorised procedure.
inputs: Actual machine-unit readiness and sequence checked in s1

steps.what: Check actual conveyor readiness after the relevant machine-unit start before the separate conveyor-start action.
inputs: Actual current equipment condition from s2
Existing approved start sequence

steps.what: Start the actual conveyors within the checked conditions and existing authorised procedure.
inputs: Actual conveyor-start conditions checked in s3

steps.what: Observe actual lights and gauges on the panel board and the physical machine operation to verify operational efficiency and recognise abnormal conditions under existing controls.
inputs: Actual running machine units and conveyors
Existing expected operating indications
outputs: Actual observed operational condition and any unresolved abnormality

steps.what: Write and check actual observed readings and abnormalities on the existing production check sheet.
inputs: Actual observations from s5

steps.what: File the exact checked production check sheet in the existing production record.
inputs: Exact checked actual entry from s6

tasks.design: Retain direct authorised starting and physical observation. The actual check-sheet writing and filing are split out and retained. No evidence establishes a remaining digital re-key or available reliable telemetry that removes this operator work.
tasks.previous_blocker: The relevant inputs are actual physical readiness and panel indications, not an existing verified digital stream.
tasks.enabler_now: No established software change removes the described work.
tasks.still_hard: Actual equipment condition and interpretation of abnormal operation.
tasks.human_edge: Observe physical equipment and apply existing operating controls.

ambition.what: No remote start or automatic safety decision.

tasks.altitude: No justified labour change for this physical task.

evidence.claim: Physical equipment starts and local panel observation require actual machine conditions; a dashboard does not itself supply that evidence.

assumptions: Shares are E1 illustrative active-work estimates, not measured baselines. This is the branch with an existing brief paper check sheet; actual writing and filing are explicitly separated. No invented second-system re-key or routine report is used to create a benefit.

The operator produces actual readiness checks in s1/s3 and actual observed readings in s5, then captures them in s6. A new sensor feed, camera, digital integration or checklist capture is not assumed free. No structured source exists here that a native software configuration can replace.

Machine-unit and conveyor order must follow the actual authorised site procedure, rather than this illustrative order if different. Existing readiness checks provide the requested physical-action gates without added approval ceremony. Changes in actual conditions require renewed checks. The ordinary completed-entry check supplies the filing gate.

No saving is assigned to existing equipment runtime, actual observation, new factual entry or the short filing action. A verified existing telemetry feed and actual duplicate entry would require a separate measured redesign; neither is asserted.
unknowns: Whether any telemetry and duplicate entry exist
research_questions: Is there an actual second-system transcription of these readings that can be removed without replacing direct observation?

already_counted.description: All actual readiness, separate starts, observation, factual record and filing remain counted.

incremental.description: No new system or process is introduced.

approvals.approved_version: Actual machine-unit start and conditions checked in s1
Actual conveyor-start conditions checked in s3
Exact actual check-sheet entry checked in s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Every actual physical action and separate record step remains at 100%; no established removable duplicate entry or digital source is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design clay forms, molds and decorations

steps.what: Examine the actual clay body, intended pottery use, existing samples and form or mold constraints before designing.
inputs: Actual clay and samples
Actual intended pottery design purpose

steps.what: Design the actual clay forms through hand sketches, physical shape exploration and assessment of proportion, function and manufacturing feasibility.
inputs: Actual material and design constraints from s1
outputs: Actual form concepts and selected geometry

steps.what: Design the molds for the actual chosen clay forms, considering the real material, release, construction and production constraints.
inputs: Actual selected form geometry from s2
Actual material and production constraints

steps.what: Design the actual decorations for the forms, judging visual balance, surface, material compatibility and the intended pottery character.
inputs: Actual form and mold designs from s2-s3
Actual material and decorative constraints

steps.what: Write the actual chosen dimensions, form, mold and decoration details on the working design sheet and check the complete final design against the physical work and constraints.
inputs: Actual selected designs from s2-s4
Actual material and use constraints

steps.what: File the exact checked form, mold and decoration design sheet in the existing design record.
inputs: Exact completed design sheet checked in s5

tasks.design: Retain actual clay-form, mold and decoration design. Separate actual design-sheet creation and filing. No repeated digital drawing, standard parametric form or second-system transcription is established to support a software saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Design choices depend on actual physical materials and original shape and decoration work.
tasks.enabler_now: No established removable administrative operation in this boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Physical form, mold feasibility and material-specific visual judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Craft knowledge and original design choices informed by actual clay.

ambition.what: No automatic manufacturing design or unvalidated generated mold geometry.

tasks.altitude: No justified time saving for this physical creative task.

evidence.claim: Original physical clay design requires material and aesthetic decisions; a generated picture alone is not a validated mold design.

assumptions: Shares are E1 illustrative active-work estimates rather than measured design baselines. Actual form design, mold design, decoration and the working design document are all included, rather than narrowing to a short creative discussion.

The potter produces actual material constraints in s1 and actual geometry/design choices in s2-s4, then captures the real selected details in s5. No pre-existing CAD geometry, structured design brief or reusable parameter library is assumed free.

Native drawing and archive tools would be the first option if actual repeated digital work were established. Here the working sheet records new design facts rather than a documented duplicate re-key. No saving is claimed for speculative image generation, CAD conversion, physical prototyping or fabrication outside the stated design work.

The ordinary completed-design check supplies the requested filing gate without new self-approval labour. Changed details require rechecking. The short filing action is fully retained and produces no saving.
research_questions: Does the potter actually repeat a digital dimensioning or transcription step that native drawing tools can remove?

already_counted.description: All actual material examination, form/mold/decoration design, factual design-sheet work and filing remain counted.

incremental.description: No new software or workflow is introduced.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed design sheet checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual design and separately identified document/filing work remain fully retained; no evidenced repeated digital operation is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Find and read the existing pottery class plan and approved material/equipment guidance in the teaching document collection {DOCS}.
inputs: Actual class and learner level
Existing pottery teaching plans and approved guidance
outputs: Applicable actual lesson and equipment sources

steps.what: Prepare the actual pottery class, materials and workspace for the learners under existing authorised equipment and material controls.
inputs: Actual lesson and guidance from s1
Actual learners, clay, tools and workspace
outputs: Actual prepared class and teaching approach

steps.what: Teach the actual pottery class through explanation, demonstration, learner practice and individual correction while directly observing tools, clay and learner understanding.
inputs: Actual prepared class from s2
Actual learner responses and work
outputs: Actual teaching, practice and observed learning

steps.what: Write and check actual class delivery, observed learner issues and next-session needs in the existing pottery teaching note {DOCS}.
inputs: Actual teaching and observations from s3

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual teaching note in {DOCS}.
inputs: Exact actual note checked in s4

tasks.design: Configure class and equipment-source views in the existing teaching folder. Keep preparation, hands-on teaching and actual learner observations with the potter. Write and separately save the real teaching note.
tasks.previous_blocker: A small amount of repeated navigation of existing class and equipment documents.
tasks.human_edge: Observe actual hands, tools, clay and understanding.

ambition.what: No automatic competence assessment or equipment authorisation.

tasks.altitude: A very small source-navigation reduction, with teaching retained.

reach.learn: Tie guidance to observed learner work

evidence.claim: Native teaching-document views can reduce source navigation without replacing pottery demonstration and practice.

assumptions: Shares are conditional E1 active-work estimates, not measured teaching baselines. The existing brief teaching note is included separately; no new attendance bureaucracy, registration service or report is invented.

Existing lesson and equipment-document authors supply current sources through unchanged work. The teacher retrieves and reads them in s1, prepares the actual class in s2 and produces real observations in s3 before recording them in s4. Missing guidance requires manual retrieval; no generated operating procedure.

Try native views before code. If sources are already immediately available, the gain is zero. No saving on physical preparation, instruction, new factual note content or same-system save. The ordinary completed-note check supplies the requested gate without additional self-approval labour; edits invalidate it. Actual delivery follows real teaching, never calendar completion.
research_questions: Does a class/equipment view remove any actual source navigation without changing practical instruction?

already_counted.description: Residual source reading, preparation, actual teaching, learner observation, factual note and save remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain the class and equipment-source view.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed actual teaching note checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 5*.30=1.5 gross less .5 upkeep gives 1. No saving on the 1% save; zero if navigation is already removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Physical production and original craft design remain unchanged; teaching sources may be slightly easier to find.
role.ambitious_version: A skilled potter whose records describe actual work and whose practical decisions remain grounded in real clay, equipment and learners.
